title: Denoise
description: Takes steady noise (hiss, room tone, rain on a recording) away: the noise level of every frequency band is estimated and subtracted.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: reduction
parameters.doc: How far the noise may be brought down. More takes more noise away and sounds more processed.

parameters.name: sensitivity
parameters.doc: How much of the estimated noise is taken away. High values are more thorough but can make the sound thin.

parameters.name: noise
parameters.doc: auto takes the quiet moments of the sound as the noise; start takes the first seconds, which must hold only noise.

parameters.name: learn
parameters.doc: How many seconds hold only noise (noise start).

parameters.name: learn_from
parameters.doc: Where the stretch that holds only noise starts, in seconds (noise start). Mark a pause between phrases.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

parameters.name: optimize
parameters.doc: An execution policy, not a sound setting: it never changes the rendered audio, only how the renderer gets there. Only matters for noise auto on a long sound, where finding the noise floor already scans the whole sound once. memory re-scans it a second time while cleaning (less memory, more time); speed keeps what the first scan found instead (more memory, less time); auto (default) picks speed when that would stay under a bounded memory budget, memory otherwise.
